hypothesis: The prior354-feature ranker used only30k sampled clicked queries. A GPU ranker over the full preceding three days may learn stronger within-event preferences; retain the successful causal neural event-click mass.
query_weights: Existing label-free evaluation history importance weights
global_probability: softmax(rank scores over ten candidates) times fixed neural003 event-click probability
selection: Fixed recipe before scoring, no grid or early stopping. Positive ordinary and adjusted lower gain interval versus V53 and neural003 on day6, then unchanged day5.
limitations: Reused development dates. No-click groups have no ranking contrast and are handled through neural event mass. No official score forecast.
